jobs.description:
Lakrids by Bülow | Copenhagen, Denmark (hybrid) - international candidates welcome | Full-time

Reports to: Head of CRM, Johanna Ternander

The Opportunity

Lakrids by Bülow has built one of the most engaged confectionery communities in the Nordics — Lakrids Lovers. The platform is growing, the data is there, and the opportunity to turn it into a genuine retention and revenue engine is significant. We are hiring a commercially minded CRM Manager to bring the strategic and analytical brain that takes Lakrids Lovers to the next level. You will own lifecycle strategy, segmentation, campaign execution and platform development, and play a key role in scaling the programme globally.

What You Will Own

CRM Strategy & Lifecycle Marketing

• 
Develop and own lifecycle marketing strategies across welcome, onboarding, retention, reactivation, post-purchase and seasonal journeys

• 
Own the CRM calendar and ensure alignment with GTM, commercial and seasonal priorities

• 
Define the commercial CRM roadmap in partnership with Head of CRM and CGMO

Lakrids Lovers Development

• 
Strengthen loyalty engagement, member value creation and community growth

• 
Improve member recruitment, activation, retention and repeat purchase frequency

• 
Develop referral and community-driven growth initiatives

• 
Support the evolution of Lakrids Lovers as a scalable global loyalty programme

Personalisation & Segmentation

• 
Build audience segmentation frameworks to improve targeting, relevance and personalisation

• 
Develop strategies for high-value customer segments including gifting buyers, Champions and high LTV customers.

• 
Support personalised customer experiences across email marketing, SMS marketing and future channels

Campaign Execution & Platform Ownership

• 
Analyse retention, repurchase behaviour, customer lifetime value and campaign effectiveness

• 
Build actionable commercial reporting and revenue attribution frameworks

• 
Leverage AI-powered tools within your CRM platform (predictive send-time, AI content generation, churn prediction)

What We Are Looking For

(Please note that the listed skills are required for this role)

• 
Min. 5 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, loyalty or retention marketing. We welcome candidates from consumer goods, retail, hospitality, travel or subscription businesses who bring commercial maturity and a fresh perspective

• 
Proven ownership of a CRM programme or loyalty programme. Not just campaign execution within one

• 
Strong commercial mindset: You think in CLV, repeat purchase rate and revenue contribution, not open rates

• 
Hands-on experience with CRM platforms: Voyado, Klaviyo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze or similar

• 
Data-literate: you segment, analyse and turn customer behaviour into actionable strategies

• 
Comfortable working with AI tools for personalisation, segmentation and content generation

• 
Experience in a brand or business where CRM is a primary revenue channel, not a support function

Fluent English. Danish, German or French a plus

What Makes You Stand Out

We are looking for candidates who bring diversity of thought and a breadth of experience. We value people who have worked across different industries, geographies or business models — and who bring a perspective that challenges how we think.

• 
You have worked in hospitality, travel or subscription — industries where retention is existential and lifecycle marketing is highly sophisticated

• 
You have experience scaling a loyalty programme across multiple markets with different consumer behaviours

• 
You bring a perspective on community and membership that goes beyond transactional loyalty

• 
You know what good looks like and how to get there

How Success Is Measured

• 
Repeat purchase rate and purchase frequency

• 
Customer lifetime value (CLV) growth across segments

• 
Lakrids Lovers member growth, activation and retention rate

• 
CRM revenue contribution and attribution

• 
Retention and engagement metrics by lifecycle stage

• 
Automation quality, deliverability and campaign effectiveness

How to Apply

Please attach your application & CV as pdf

Build commercial business cases and launch P&Ls in partnership with Finance

Analyse assortment profitability, hero SKU contribution and margin mix

Act as the connective tissue between Innovation, Supply Chain, Sales, Marketing, Ecommerce and CRM

Establish scalable ways of working and shared launch processes across the business

Capture and systematically implement learnings from each launch cycle

Min. 5 years of experience in product management, brand management or product marketing — we welcome candidates from both consumer goods and adjacent industries who bring a fresh perspective

Proven ownership of product launch processes end-to-end — from brief to shelf to post-launch review

Strong commercial acumen: P&L literacy, pricing logic, assortment and range planning thinking

Experience building or significantly improving launch governance or stage-gate processes

You have worked across more than one industry or business model — retail, DTC, wholesale, B2B — and you bring that breadth to how you think about product

You have experience in categories beyond food — lifestyle, beauty, home, fashion — where product storytelling and commercial discipline coexist

You have worked in both large structured organisations and leaner scale-ups, and you know how to operate in both

You have a track record of challenging the status quo on assortment complexity — and winning the argument commercially

How Success Is Measured

On-time and on-brief launch rate across all categories

SKU productivity and portfolio gross margin improvement

Launch sell-through performance vs. forecast

jobs.occupation: Experienced Welder / Tack Welder for Weekend Day Shift
jobs.description:
Do you have solid experience in welding and tack welding, and do you thrive in a structured environment with clear expectations and a strong focus on quality and precision? At Give Steel A/S, you will become an important part of our weekend day shift production team, where your contribution helps ensure strong, documented steel structures.

Why Choose Us?

You will become part of a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company with a strong focus on quality, safety, and responsible production. We are committed to employee development and offer a workplace with freedom under responsibility, well-organised working conditions, and opportunities for professional growth.

You will be employed under the Danish Collective Agreement for the Industry Sector (Industriens Overenskomst). In addition, we offer private health insurance and the option to join our canteen scheme.

What Will Your Workday Look Like?

You will join a team manufacturing load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. The work is carried out on the weekend day shift, where you will follow established work procedures and contribute to ensuring tasks are completed safely, efficiently, and to a high standard of quality.

Your working hours will be from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Tack welding and welding steel structures based on technical drawings and work instructions

• Preparing components and checking measurements, fit, and quality

• Carrying out tasks with a systematic and thorough approach

• Contributing to strong teamwork with colleagues in production

• Complying with all applicable safety, quality, and documentation requirements

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for an experienced and reliable employee who works in a structured and detail-oriented manner. You thrive in a well-defined environment, can maintain an overview in a busy production setting, and take pride in delivering lasting, high-quality results.

We expect that you:

• Have solid experience as a welder and/or tack welder

• Work thoroughly, responsibly, and with a strong focus on quality

• Can read and understand technical drawings

• Are reliable and a team player

• Contribute positively to a professional and safe working environment

• Speak Danish and/or English

• Live in Denmark within a reasonable commuting distance of Brande

We can provide certification in various welding methods, so it is not important whether you already hold welding certificates.

Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, please contact our Head of Production, Tomas Slepavicius, at tsl@givesteel.com.

We would like to receive your CV, clearly outlining your relevant experience. We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible, and we will remove the job advertisement once the position has been filled.

About Give Steel A/S

Give Steel A/S is a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company that develops, designs, manufactures, and erects load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. Quality, safety, and documentation are an integral part of our daily operations, while we also maintain a strong focus on CO₂ reduction and responsible production.

You will become part of an international company with strong technical expertise and opportunities for professional development. Collaboration, responsibility, and integrity are key values in our daily work.

jobs.occupation: Steel Fitters Wanted
jobs.description:
Scan Con Constraction is not a Temp Company (Er ikke et Vikar firma)

We are looking for:

Steel Fitters

Key tasks:

Your job as steel fitter will be responsible for assembling, positioning, aligning, and fitting structural steel components to create frameworks for buildings, bridges, ships, and heavy machinery.

 Your key responsibilities & duties will include:

·         Blueprint Interpretation: Study engineering drawings, blueprints, and material lists to plan the sequence of tasks and determine material requirements.

·         Layout and Fabrication: Layout reference points and patterns on heavy metal to prepare for cutting, bending, and forming.

·         Assembly and Fitting: Assemble, align, and fit metal sections and plates to form complete units or subunits, using tack welding, bolting, or riveting.

·         Machine Operation: Operate heavy-duty machinery such as cranes, shearers, brake presses, grinders, drills, and cutting torches to prepare components.

·         Quality Inspection: Inspect and test completed components to ensure they meet specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations.

·         Positioning and Installation: Position parts in jigs (sometimes created by tack-welding scrap metal) and use grinders, chisels, or files to ensure precise fits.

Skills:

·         English - must be able to communicate in English 

·         Technical Knowledge: Proficient in reading blueprints and technical drawings.

·         Fabrication Skills: Experience (good to have) with metal fabrication techniques, including tack welding, oxy-acetylene cutting, and operating shop machinery.

·         Mathematical Skills: Strong understanding of shop math for measuring, layout, and calculations.

·         Physical Demands: Ability to perform physically demanding work, including standing for long periods, bending, lifting heavy loads, and sometimes working at heights.

·         Safety Adherence: Strict compliance with occupational health and safety (OHS) standards and proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

jobs.occupation: Project & Business Coordinator
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning plans into action and bringing structure to complex, cross-functional initiatives?  

Avincis is looking for a Project & Business Coordinator to join our Nordic organisation. This is a broad and highly collaborative role where you will work closely with our Nordic management team and colleagues across Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark. 

You will be at the centre of projects, business improvement initiatives and management activities that span functions and countries. From coordinating strategic projects and Management of Change processes to supporting business cases, contracts and performance reporting, you will help ensure that priorities move forward and that decisions are translated into action. 

For the right person, this is an excellent opportunity to gain broad exposure to a complex, international aviation business and work closely with senior management.

Location: Stockholm, Tromsø or Esbjerg

Reports to: Managing Director Nordics

The role

As our Project & Business Coordinator, you will support and coordinate strategic initiatives and cross-functional projects across the Nordic organisation. 

You will bring structure, follow-up and momentum to projects and business activities, while also supporting the Nordic management team with analysis, reporting, contracts and decision-making material. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

• 
Coordinating cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives across the Nordics 

• 
Developing and maintaining project plans, milestones, budgets, risk registers and progress reporting 

• 
Coordinating Management of Change (MOC) processes and ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-up 

• 
Supporting the preparation of business cases, investment proposals and cost-saving initiatives 

• 
Facilitating project meetings, workshops and steering group meetings and following up agreed actions 

• 
Supporting contract administration, negotiations, renewals and amendments 

• 
Supporting commercial activities and tender processes 

• 
Preparing management reports, presentations and decision-making material 

• 
Analysing operational and financial performance and supporting KPI and dashboard reporting 

• 
Identifying opportunities to improve, simplify and standardise processes across the Nordic organisation 

• 
Supporting strategic planning, organisational development and change initiatives 

• 
Acting as a connecting point between management, operational teams and support functions across countries 

Who are we looking for?

We believe you are a structured and proactive person who enjoys working in an environment where priorities can change and where collaboration is essential. 

You are comfortable coordinating several activities at the same time and know how to create clarity and progress without losing sight of the bigger picture. You enjoy working with people across different functions and levels of an organisation and are confident interacting with senior stakeholders. 

You probably have experience from project coordination, project management, business support, business development or a similar role. 

We would also like you to have: 

• 
Strong organisational and project management or coordination skills 

• 
An understanding of financial analysis and business cases 

• 
Good analytical and problem-solving capabilities 

• 
Experience or understanding of contract administration and commercial processes 

• 
An understanding of risk management and governance 

• 
Strong communication skills in English and at least one Nordic language 

• 
Experience supporting management teams and senior stakeholders 

• 
Experience from aviation or another regulated industry, tender or procurement processes, Management of Change and/or SAP is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What will make you successful? 

You are someone who takes ownership and makes things happen. You enjoy creating structure where there are many moving parts, following up on actions and ensuring that projects continue to move forward. 

At the same time, you are curious about the business behind the projects. You want to understand why we are doing something, not just what needs to be done. 

You are collaborative, pragmatic and comfortable working across different countries, functions and cultures. 

Why join Avincis? 

At Avincis, our work has a clear purpose. We provide critical aviation services across Europe, supporting missions where aviation makes a real difference. 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work across our Nordic organisation and gain insight into many different parts of the business. You will work closely with Nordic management while collaborating with colleagues in operations, finance, safety, HR, procurement and other functions. 

It is a role with broad exposure, significant variety and the opportunity to influence how we work across the Nordics. 

If you are looking for a role where you can combine projects, business, analysis and collaboration – and where no two days are quite the same – we would love to hear from you. 

Ready to take the next step? Apply and become part of Avincis Nordics.

About Lolland and Relocation Support

Lolland is located in the southern part of Denmark, offering a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to nature, beaches, and open countryside. The region combines affordable housing, short commuting distances, and a strong sense of community.

The region is currently experiencing significant development, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link, one of Europe's largest infrastructure projects, which will create a direct road and rail connection between Denmark and Germany.

As an international employee, you will have access to Lolland Municipality's Newcomers Service, which offers free support with relocation, registration, housing guidance, partner job support, and settling into life in Denmark.

For more information about Lolland and contact details, visit https://newcomers.lolland.dk/

More information about living and working in Denmark can be found at www.workindenmark.dk
